title: Senior Infrastructure Software Engineer, Apps Platform
description: <p>Senior Infrastructure Software Engineer, Apps Platform, London</p> <p> </p> <p>As an Infrastructure Engineer on the Apps Platform Infrastructure team, you'll help build and evolve our platform’s deployment and observability layers across multiple cloud providers and on-premises, for both internal and customer-managed environments. This is a role for someone who cares about building cloud-agnostic infrastructure and deployment pipelines.</p> <p>You'll partner closely with internal teams to understand how they use and deploy the platform, debug their issues, and shape a roadmap that balances immediate needs with long-term architecture.</p> <h3>You will:</h3> <ul> <li>Expand the deployment footprint of our platform to cover both on-premise, all major cloud platforms and beyond</li> <li>Ensure fast, secure, and reproducible deployments across all supported CSPs and on-prem  </li> <li>Expand the observability of the platform so that forward deployed infrastructure teams can easily and efficiently operate customer deployments</li> <li>Partner closely with internal teams deploying the platform to understand their needs, debug issues, and build tooling that serves their use cases</li> <li>Respond to incidents and production issues with urgency, conducting root cause analysis and implementing preventive fixes</li> <li>Help develop and maintain a product roadmap for deployment and observability</li> <li>Lead architecture reviews and own projects end-to-end, from design through deployment, in fast-paced cross-functional settings</li> </ul> <h3>Ideally you'd have:</h3> <ul> <li>7+ years of experience building and deploying enterprise and public sector solutions across AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI and on-premises</li> <li>Deep expertise in infrastructure design, networking engineering, VPNs, load balancers, and firewalls</li> <li>Deep proficiency with IaC, containerisation and orchestration tools and technologies (Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker)</li> <li>Comprehensive understanding of CI/CD pipelines and software delivery principles using GitHub Actions or CircleCI.</li> <li>Experience with GitOps-style deployments and a track record of ensuring consistent, repeatable deployments</li> <li>Strong debugging skills and the ability to navigate performance/security tradeoffs in production systems</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to context-switch between reactive incident work and proactive product development</li> </ul> <h3>Nice to haves:</h3> <ul> <li>Experience as a founder or early engineer at an infrastructure-focused startup, owning a product end-to-end</li> <li>Experience running secure workloads in multi-tenant or untrusted environments (e.g., FaaS, CI sandboxes, remote notebooks)</li> <li>Open-source contributions to systems or developer-tools projects</li> <li>History of on-call/incident response for production systems</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong><em>PLEASE NOTE: </em></strong><em>Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants.</em></p> <p><strong>About Us:</strong></p> <p><em>At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, </em><em>Ernst</em><em> </em><em>&</em><em> Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force. We are expanding our team to accelerate the development of AI applications.</em></p> <p><em>We believe that everyone should be able to bring their whole selves to work, which is why we are proud to be an inclusive and equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability status, gender identity or Veteran status. </em></p> <p><em>We are committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. title: Data and AI Engineer Director | Market Lead
description: <div class="description content"> <p><strong>Data and AI Engineer (Market Lead), UKI</strong></p> <br> <p><strong>Data and AI Engineer (Market Lead), UKI</strong> · Director level · London preferred</p> <p>We are looking for a Director-level Market Lead to head our Data & AI practice in the UK & Ireland. This is a hybrid leadership role. You combine deep technical solutioning with real commercial skill, and you are credible both in an architecture debate and across the table from a CDO, CIO or CFO.</p> <p> Our delivery model is shifting from large time-and-materials teams to small, AI-first pods working against a business outcome. As Market Lead, you will shape how we take that model to UKI clients: what we sell, how we price it, and how we staff and deliver it. You will lead a core team of 5–6 direct reports and a wider matrix of around 50-75 people across UKI, and you will help them build the skills this shift requires. We are developing these ways of working together.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Main focus and responsibilities:</strong></p> <p><strong>Commercial and solutioning</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive commercial success on complex Data & AI deals across UKI, from shaping the opportunity through to a signed deal. This includes structuring fixed-price and outcome-linked commercial models, and understanding delivery cost, margin and risk.</li> <li>Partner with tech advisory and industry domain leads from pre-sale through delivery, so the commercial story, the architecture and the sector insight reinforce one another.</li> <li>Frame and test business-outcome hypotheses with executives, and define thin slices of delivery that prove value quickly.</li> <li>You stay close enough to delivery to know what is realistic, and you share accountability for outcomes on the deals you sell.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Practice leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Spearhead growth of the UKI Data & AI practice: build, lead, scale and mentor a high-performing team.</li> <li>Work with delivery and talent leads to match demand with capacity, so the right people and pods are available when deals land. Keep specialist skills sourced and bench waste low.</li> <li>Shift the practice's capability mix towards production AI engineering and agentic delivery, through hiring, reskilling and role-based onboarding.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Client engagement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage executive-level relationships with CDOs, CIOs, CISOs and other CXOs. Act as a sparring partner on AI strategy: challenge assumptions, size the opportunity, and help clients decide where agentic automation and AI can move the P&L.</li> <li>Build and manage robust sales pipelines and lead strategic client workshops.</li> <li>Advise clients on responsible AI, covering risk, governance and regulatory expectations in the UK and wider markets.</li> <li>Expected to lead and drive P&L with TCV of 50 -75 M GBP and ACV of 45-50 M GBP/</li> <li>Expected experience and capabilities in driving all P&L criterias including sales, margin, utilization, bench management, training, learning, partnership based sales etc.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>I</strong><strong>deal candidate profile</strong></p> <p>The successful candidate is a true dual-threat practitioner, equally at home in a complex architecture discussion and in closing a large commercial deal.</p> <br> <table> <tbody> <tr> <td> <p><strong>Criterion</strong></p> </td> <td> <p><strong>Requirement</strong></p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p>Experience</p> </td> <td> <p>Significant senior experience in data and AI consulting, typically 15+ years, with a track record in leadership roles. You are neither a pure solution architect nor a pure sales profile.</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p>Commercial track record</p> </td> <td> <p>History of selling multiple large-scale data and AI deals, ideally including recent GenAI or agentic engagements, and able to discuss deal shape, pricing structure, trade-offs and delivery and business value delivery in concrete terms.</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p>Technical expertise</p> </td> <td> <p>Strong solutioning background in complex ecosystems: data platforms and data products, data governance, and AI systems in production, including agentic and LLM-based systems. You understand failure modes, evaluation, cost and risk, not just architecture diagrams.</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p>Data/AI balance</p> </td> <td> <p>Roughly 70/30, with demonstrable recent depth in AI (last 2–4 years), for example AI agents, AI advisory or AI foundations with large UK clients. Data depth is the foundation, but hand on AI credibility is required.</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p>Tech stack</p> </td> <td> <p>Strong cloud proficiency in at least one major platform (GCP, AWS or Azure). Snowflake or Databricks experience is a strong plus. Familiarity with the AI tooling and model platforms available on those clouds is expected. Experience on NVIDIA and other modern tech stacks will be great addition<strong>.</strong></p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p>Commercial acumen</p> </td> <td> <p>Comfortable with P&L, business cases and ROI conversations, and able to negotiate with CFO-level stakeholders.</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p>Leadership</p> </td> <td> <p>Experience leading and scaling teams of this size, in a matrix, through change.</p> </td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <br><br><strong>Location and travel</strong> <ul> <li>UK-wide remit. London-based candidates (or within about a two-hour commute) are preferred, with 1–2 days a week in the London office for collaboration and leadership visibility. </li> <li>Weekly once or twice travel to customer location in UKI. </li> </ul> <h4><strong>Soft skills and cultural fit</strong></h4> <ul> <li>You bring drive and resilience, and you build momentum in a fast-changing environment<strong>.</strong></li> <li>Executive presence: exceptional communication, with real C-level exposure and comfort presenting and negotiating with CDOs and CXOs.</li> <li>Facilitation of strategic workshops and consultative client conversations.</li> <li>Comfort leading through ambiguity while the delivery model and competency frameworks are still maturing.</li> <li>A coaching mindset: you grow other leaders and raise AI fluency across the team.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Learning & Development</strong></p> <ul> <li>There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. </li> <li>But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. </li> <li>This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. </li> <li>We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment</strong></p> <ul> <li>At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.</li> <li>Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.</li> <li>We are committed to fairness and responsible AI. We actively manage our AI systems by testing, monitoring for biased outcomes and implementing mitigation measures. We hold our third-party vendors to these same high standards through a rigorous governance process. For additional information, please see our full Thoughtworks AI Policy for Recruitment.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About Thoughtwork</strong><strong>s</strong></p> <ul> <li>Thoughtworks is a dynamic and inclusive community of bright and supportive colleagues who are revolutionizing tech. As a leading technology consultancy, we're pushing boundaries through our purposeful and impactful work. </li> <li>For 30+ years, we've delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology as the differentiator. </li> <li>Bring your brilliant expertise and commitment for continuous learning to Thoughtworks. Together, let's be extraordinary.</li> </ul> </div> <div class="job-qualifications content"> <div class="skills inner-content"> <h2> </h2> </div> </div> <p style="display: none;">#LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p style="text-align: center;"><a href="https://www.thoughtworks.com/careers/ai-policy-for-recruitment">See here our AI policy.</a></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Client Director - UK and Europe Airline Industry  - Digital and Data Services
description: <div> <div class="description content"> <p>We are seeking to expand our Go-To-Market team in RCTT (short for Retail, Consumer, Travel and Transportation) in Europe with a special focus on the Retail sector in the UK&I. </p> <p>Specifically, we are looking for a leader who is experienced with selling and delivering digital transformations encompassing our core offerings of Customer Experience, Product Innovation, Enterprise Platform Modernization, Data Modernization, AI Readiness, Engineering Excellence and Digital Application and Maintenance Operations (DAMO). </p> <p>You will be inheriting one large portfolio in the Retail space based on which you will grow the existing account, and acquire new accounts based on your network, your industry expertise and our marketing activities and in close collaboration with your account team, our industry and service line specialists and the RCTT market organization. </p> <p>As a Client Principals, you are responsible for the entire sales cycle (lead generation through proposal, contract negotiation and closure) as well as client relationship management, account strategy and planning, joint delivery governance and project reviews. </p> <p>This includes e.g. </p> <p>● Understand the industry context, the customer problem and define mutual value ● Develop and execute on key account plans and overall go-to-market </p> <p>● Acquire and nurture senior client relationships on strategic accounts </p> <p>● Achieve established revenue and profitability targets </p> <p>● Work closely with the account leadership team (consisting e.g. of the account tech director and account delivery director) </p> <p>● Actively participate in the go-to-market plan creation/refinement for your account as well as for the industry vertical (RCTT), and </p> <p>● Report account activity, opportunity status and other details to the RCTT leadership (portfolio director)</p> </div> <h2 id="job-responsibilities">Job responsibilities</h2> <div class="job-responsibilities content"> <ul> <li> Establish, build, and maintain long-term, value-based relationships with a growing number of senior client stakeholders.</li> <li> Farm and manage between one and three accounts at a time (including 1-2 prospect accounts). </li> <li> Drive $20 million to $50 million in revenue per year from accounts to meet or exceed profitability targets. </li> <li>Ensure the creation and execution of existing account strategies, and build “win-win” value propositions at the company and individual levels. </li> <li>Help develop a range of IP and best practices around client and portfolio development in order to build the client base into a significant strategic asset. </li> <li>Approach client executives as true business partners versus software delivery partners, expanding the company’s breadth and depth to its full potential. </li> <li> Work on continuous margin improvement in sold and delivered margin.</li> </ul> </div> <h2 id="job-qualifications">Job qualifications</h2> <div class="job-qualifications content"> <h3 id="technical-skills">Technical Skills</h3> <div class="qualifications inner-content"> <ul> <li> A deep understanding of the retail (and ideally also the consumer goods) industry, familiarity with the main industry trends and drivers as well as relevant players (e.g. eco-system partners). </li> <li>A strong network in the industry. </li> <li> Experience working in many different executive revenue-generating roles requiring strong business acumen. </li> <li>Success managing and developing sophisticated senior client relationships and strategic business partnerships across the C-suite. </li> <li>Experience contributing to a clients’ business using a highly consultative We operate where the demands of autonomy push conventional cloud architectures to their limits.</p> <p>As the Principal Architect for Autonomous Vehicles, you will have founding-team-level influence and own the overarching product and technical strategy for CoreWeave's autonomous vehicle offering. You will shape the roadmap across data processing, distributed training, simulation and validation, working alongside product, research, engineering and commercial stakeholders.</p> <p>This hands-on technical leadership role spans the full stack, from bare-metal GPU/CPU topologies, networking and storage through workload orchestration to application-facing APIs and autonomous driving software ecosystems, including NVIDIA's. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. </strong></p> <p><strong>We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. </strong><br><strong> </strong><br><strong>We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.</strong><br><strong> </strong><br><strong>Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. </strong><br><strong> </strong><br><strong>For more information, visit <a href="https://eur02.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=http%3A%2F%2Fwpp.com%2F&data=05%7C02%7CErica.Durr%40wpp.com%7C9bf4566a65bc46a48ac008de749116ea%7C150b5e663d884dee83f6ed149b727a00%7C0%7C0%7C639076363668176216%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=Q9juosud56XGLThSFZ1NpPZd6FXpJPxV74OeRZWoh%2B4%3D&reserved=0" target="_blank">WPP.com.</a></strong><br><strong> </strong></p></div><h1>About WPP</h1> <p>WPP is the creative transformation company. Through One WPP and the Elevate28 transformation agenda, we are building a simpler, more integrated, agile and AI-powered enterprise. WPP’s Performance & Culture Center of Excellence brings together the capabilities that help our people, teams and organisation perform, grow and thrive. Within it, Enterprise Effectiveness aligns WPP’s organisation, workforce and teams around its strategic priorities and enables the change required to deliver them.</p> <h1>About the Role</h1> <p>The Workforce Intelligence & Analytics Manager is a contract role that will build the evidence base for the workforce and organisation decisions that matter most to WPP. This role will turn fragmented people, organisation and business data into clear insight, forward-looking scenarios and practical recommendations that help leaders decide where to invest, how to shape the workforce and how to organise for performance.</p> <p>Reporting to the Global Head of Enterprise Effectiveness, you will support the wider Performance & Culture Center of Excellence while working closely with business, People & Culture, Finance, Data and Technology partners. You will establish a trusted workforce-intelligence capability that supports strategic workforce planning and informs priority organisation, workforce, team and people decisions across Enterprise Effectiveness and the wider Performance & Culture Center of Excellence. This is not a traditional reporting role. It combines strategic analytics, internal consulting and leadership of a four-person data and reporting team based in India. You will be expected to work through ambiguity, connect disparate data and systems, and progressively turn fragmented analytics into a more integrated, trusted and usable capability. As a contract appointment, the initial focus will be to establish the core workforce-intelligence approach, strengthen the India-based team and deliver insight against WPP’s highest-priority workforce and organisation questions.</p> <h1>Why This Role Matters</h1> <p>WPP’s transformation requires faster, better choices about work, skills, capacity, organisation and investment. Those choices cannot be made from disconnected dashboards or backward-looking metrics alone. In this role, you will create a more integrated view of the workforce, translate evidence into choices and trade-offs, and help leaders anticipate the implications of AI, changing client demand and new ways of working. The work will directly shape how WPP builds the capabilities, capacity and organisation required for Elevate28.</p> <h1>What You’ll Do</h1> <h2>Build a trusted workforce intelligence capability</h2> <ul> <li>Working with the Global Head of Enterprise Effectiveness, shape and build an enterprise workforce-intelligence approach that connects people, organisation and business data to the decisions leaders need to make.</li> <li>Define a focused set of workforce and organisational measures, dashboards and decision-support tools, moving reporting from activity and headcount toward capacity, capability, cost, productivity, risk and value.</li> <li>Partner with data owners and technology teams to map fragmented data and systems, define analytical requirements, and strengthen data definitions, quality, accessibility and responsible use, while being clear about limitations and the strength of the evidence.</li> <li>Establish repeatable analytical standards, governance and quality controls so insight is trusted, comparable and usable across WPP.</li> <li>Apply AI and automation to improve how workforce data is integrated, analysed and translated into decision support, while maintaining appropriate human judgement, transparency and responsible-use standards.</li> </ul> <h2>Enable strategic workforce planning</h2> <ul> <li>Help business and People & Culture leaders translate strategy, growth priorities and choices about how work is organised into workforce demand, capability and capacity requirements.</li> <li>Build scenarios that show the implications of different choices, including developing, hiring, accessing external capability, automating, augmenting, redeploying and exiting work or roles.</li> <li>Assess the current workforce and future talent supply, including critical skills, capacity, cost, location and role mix, highlighting gaps, risks and investment priorities.</li> <li>Connect workforce planning to business and financial planning cycles so decisions are timely, owned and grounded in common assumptions.</li> </ul> <h2>Deliver forward-looking insight and decision support</h2> <ul> <li>Use statistical analysis, forecasting and scenario modelling to identify emerging workforce and organisational risks, opportunities and patterns.</li> <li>Bring structure to ambiguous business questions, identify what can be answered with available data, test hypotheses and distinguish meaningful signals from correlation or noise.</li> <li>Turn analysis into clear choices, trade-offs and recommendations for senior leaders, including the consequences of action and inaction.</li> <li>Develop concise executive narratives and visualisations that make complex findings understandable without oversimplifying them.</li> </ul> <h2>Strengthen organisation and transformation decisions</h2> <ul> <li>Provide analytical support for organisation design, organisational health, inclusion and impact, talent development, team effectiveness and change priorities across Performance and Culture.</li> <li>Create baselines and evaluate whether organisation and workforce interventions are improving the intended outcomes.</li> <li>Combine quantitative evidence with qualitative insight to explain not only what is happening, but why it matters and where targeted action is needed.</li> <li>Identify enterprise patterns across businesses, markets and functions and convert them into practical recommendations for leaders and Enterprise Effectiveness partners.</li> </ul> <h2>Scale tools, capability and adoption</h2> <ul> <li>Build practical tools, templates and self-service products that improve the quality and consistency of workforce decisions.</li> <li>Coach People & Culture and business partners to interpret workforce insight, challenge assumptions and use scenarios in decision-making.</li> <li>Create a clear intake and prioritisation approach that focuses analytical capacity on the highest-value enterprise questions.</li> <li>Continuously improve the offer through user feedback, adoption evidence and emerging practice in workforce analytics, AI and organisational science.</li> <li>Lead and develop a four-person data and reporting team based in India, setting clear priorities, strengthening analytical and consulting capability, and shifting delivery from fragmented reporting toward higher-value workforce intelligence and decision support.</li> </ul> <h1>Minimum Qualifications</h1> <ul> <li>Relevant experience applying data and analytics in finance, commercial, operational or other business settings, together with experience in people analytics, workforce intelligence or strategic workforce planning.</li> <li>Experience translating business questions into analytical approaches, workforce scenarios and decision-ready recommendations.</li> <li>Strong capability in data analysis, forecasting, modelling and visualisation, using appropriate business intelligence or analytical tools.</li> <li>Proven experience working through ambiguity and improving a fragmented data and analytics environment by connecting disparate sources and systems, strengthening definitions and quality, and establishing practical governance, privacy and ethical standards.</li> <li>Ability to communicate complex findings clearly and influence senior stakeholders in a complex locations.</li> <li>A degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent practical experience.</li> </ul> <h1>Preferred Experience</h1> <ul> <li>Experience applying financial, commercial or operational analysis to workforce investment, capacity, productivity or organisation decisions.</li> <li>Experience in a complex global, matrixed or multi-business organisation, ideally supporting enterprise R.</li> <li>Postgraduate study or relevant professional qualifications in analytics, finance, strategic workforce planning or a related field.</li> </ul> <h1>What Success Looks Like</h1> <ul> <li>A description: <p><strong>Job title:</strong> Product Manager - Device Data Management (Fluent French & English) <br><br><strong>Location:</strong> Paris — Hybrid (3 days in office)<br><br><strong>Salary:</strong> €57,600 - €72,000<br><br><strong>Team:</strong> Product Management - Data Device Management <br><br><strong>Reporting to: </strong>Group Product Manager</p> <p><strong>This role is based in Paris, France and requires the successful candidate to be based in or willing to relocate to Paris. Be the go-to person for this product area in France, and act as the link between our global and local teams to inform priorities and strategy.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>About You<br><br>Ideally you'll have/be:<br></strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Proven experience </strong>as a Product Manager, Business Analyst, or<strong> </strong>equivalent role in software companies, with a strong track record of successfully localising complex software products for international markets</li> <li><strong>Previous experience in the French energy industry</strong> — you know how the market works and its key players (e.g. Enedis / GRDF), especially around device data and market flows. Experience with energy management or utility platforms in the French market is a strong plus.</li> <li><strong>Fluent in French and very comfortable in English</strong> — our platform and many of our teams operate in English, so you move easily between both.</li> <li><strong>Confident working directly with clients</strong> — you can run a working session with client stakeholders, draw out the real requirement behind the ask, and keep senior people aligned and brought in.</li> <li><strong>A builder's mentality</strong> — resourceful and hands-on, comfortable building a working prototype rather than waiting for the perfect specification.</li> <li><strong>Technically comfortable</strong> — at ease with data and data models, databases, and APIs, and able to prototype with modern AI tooling. Equally happy reasoning about a data model and about what the end user sees on screen.</li> <li><strong>A clear, sharp communicator</strong> — able to cut through noise and articulate technical and market complexity to a range of stakeholders, including clients.</li> <li><strong>Experience collaborating across cross-functional teams</strong> — engineering, QA, BA, Programme, Delivery etc — to deliver localised solutions.</li> <li><strong>Proficiency in AI tools </strong>throughout all stages of the product lifecycle — from discovery and ideation to delivery and iteration.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Kaluza Values</strong></p> <p>Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business: </p> <p><strong>Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together</strong></p> <table> <tbody> <tr> <td> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p><strong>We want the best people</strong></p> <p>We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. title: Mobile Developer - L5
description: 📍 Manchester (Hybrid, up to 4 days WFH) | 💰 £75,000 Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everybody by elevating UK Estate Agencies through world-class technology. Our products, Street.co.uk and Spectre form a powerful duo, working harmoniously together to transform an agent's job. From securing more leads and winning new instructions to streamlining business operations and growing market share, our products are supercharging 1,000s of agencies across the UK. How we work in 2026 Engineering at Street Group has changed. Most of us don't write code by hand day-to-day anymore - agents do; we direct. For our mobile team, that shifts where the value is: when AI handles more of the code, what matters most is how the app looks, how it feels, what it does for the user and the ideas you bring to it. Understanding the product and the people using it sits at the heart of the role: we expect engineers to know why they're building something, not just how. Being genuinely tuned into AI tooling is core to the role here, not a side skill and if you'd rather not work this way, that's fair but we're probably not the place for you. Equally, if you see mobile engineering as getting code onto a screen and calling it "good enough", this probably isn't the role for you either. We're a small, autonomous mobile team working on what we think is the best PropTech app on the market. There's no micromanagement and no fixed sprint rituals: when a new project kicks off we get together as a "three amigos" with product and design, get the first tickets out, then keep the conversation going as the work develops. You'll have dedicated backend, design and product colleagues alongside you, and full freedom over how you work. If you love autonomy, are naturally curious, and want to have a genuine impact within a growing company, we think you'd fit right in! Here's what you can expect to be working on as a Mobile Developer (L5) at Street Group Owning the end-to-end delivery of significant features in our React Native app: scoping the problem, directing the build, testing, shipping and iterating based on what you learn. Directing agent sessions to deliver work, while your own attention goes on the user experience, platform feel and the decisions where your judgement is required. Making every experience feel natural on both iOS and Android - understanding what users on each platform expect, and building for it. Looking after the live app: monitoring, stability and our weekly releases across the App Store and Google Play. Defining what success looks like before you build, analysing how features perform after release, and proactively bringing the results - good or bad, backed by data - to product and design. Being a regular voice in product discussions: taking a loose "what if we..." idea and turning it into a strong first version. Picking up tech debt and spotting improvements alongside your main feature, keeping the app maintainable and extendable. Helping to shape new mobile work as it expands across more of the business, including consumer monetisation and lettings. A bit about you You have commercial experience building and shipping production apps with React Native and TypeScript, on both iOS and Android. You work AI-natively as a default, using tools like Claude Code fluently - and you understand what the AI produces well enough to explain and own it. If your current employer doesn't allow AI tools, we'd expect you've been exploring them in your own time. You have strong product and design sense: you're user-focused and care about how something feels to use, not just whether it works. You take quality seriously - your work is tested, solid and thought through before it ships. You've looked after a live app and see its stability, monitoring and releases as part of your job. You're comfortable working independently with loose guidelines, and you're a confident communicator who'll share ideas and challenge in discussions. Experience using analytics to measure features and inform what comes next is a bonus. Why join Street Group? 🏠 Hybrid-working - you can work from home up to 4 days per week 🏖️ Guilt-Free R&R - £1000 towards a holiday after your first year with the team (we'll even cover the tax!) 💪 Joining a culture that supports your development and encourages growth 📚 £500 yearly L&D budget for your career development 🎂 Your birthday on us - we pay, you stay away 🙋 'Give something back' - 2 paid days volunteering on us 👶 Enhanced maternity, paternity & adoption pay 🧠 Mental health & well-being support via Health Assured 🧘 Regular well-being initiatives 🕒 Flexible working hours 🚂 Public transport season ticket loans 🌷 Paid menopause leave 🌞 Holiday buying scheme 🚀 Joining a new team in an exciting business with huge ambition 👥 Be a part of something bigger - everyone in our team is passionate about improving the entire property industry! It's a huge goal, but it motivates us to do better every single day 👩🏿‍💻 A chance to work on cutting-edge technology 🐶 Comfortable, relaxed office space - office dogs welcome! 🍻 Fully stocked fridge and beers (or an alternative) on us every Friday afternoon 🎊 Company and team off-sites, events and happy hours 🚴 Cycle to work scheme 🚗 Electric car salary sacrifice scheme 🌍 Feel good about sustainability - we're a climate-positive company! Research has shown that women tend to rule themselves out of applying for jobs unless they meet 100% of the requirements. If you fall into that category and were about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria; please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application! Salary £75,000 dependent on experience. However, sometimes the perfect person is far more or less experienced than we anticipated. In these situations, planned ranges go out the window. If you think that might be the case, please apply and just let us know. We care deeply about helping the tech industry become a more inclusive and diverse place and we work hard to lead by example. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all. Candidates must be eligible to live and work in the UK and be able to perform the work specified. Interview Process 4 stages (incl. tech task) = An introductory call with one of our Talent team > Take-home tech task > Technical Interview > Final culture fit interview. We want to make our interviews as inclusive as possible, so if you need any adjustments made, or if there's anything you think we should be aware of during the interview process, please do let us know. A note on using AI in your job application As a fast-moving and rapidly evolving tech company, we embrace the advantages of AI and encourage its use throughout our application process. However, our goal is to get to know and hire the authentic you - your skills, experience, and values. We don't want to hire an AI-generated version of you. We consider AI to be a valuable tool, not something that should overshadow you as an individual. How we use AI in the hiring process Candidate experience is really important to us, and our Talent team use AI notetakers during interviews so they can focus purely on their conversation with you. All hiring decisions are made by humans - not AI. Let us know if you have any questions! title: Revenue Operations Analyst (London)
description: Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. Note: this role is based remotely out of London, UK. Regional Expectations Based in London with strong overlap to customer business hours. Excellent written and spoken English. Additional European languages are a plus. The Opportunity Deepgram is hiring a Revenue Operations Analyst to help build and operate the systems, data, and workflows that power our GTM organization. This is a hands-on role for someone who likes getting into the details: fixing broken workflows, improving data quality, supporting quote-to-cash and usage-based billing processes, and finding ways to automate repetitive work. You’ll work closely with GTM Engineering, Finance, Sales, Customer Success, and Renewals to make our commercial systems more reliable, scalable, and efficient. What You’ll Do Support and improve quote-to-cash workflows, including CPQ, order forms, contract changes, subscriptions, entitlements, and downstream system updates. Partner with Finance and GTM Engineering on usage, billing, and monetization workflows, including reconciliation across CRM, product, billing, and finance systems. Serve as a hands-on Salesforce and GTM systems operator, building reports, dashboards, flows, automations, and system enhancements. Maintain strong data quality and governance across accounts, opportunities, contracts, usage, renewals, and customer records. Troubleshoot and resolve GTM systems and process issues, identifying root causes rather than relying on manual workarounds. Identify repetitive or high-friction workflows and help build automation and AI-enabled solutions to reduce manual effort. Support the systems and reporting used to operationalize forecasting, routing, territory, quota, and commission decisions. Partner with the Director, GTM Engineering on system requirements, testing, implementation, documentation, and ongoing optimization. Help create scalable operating processes as Deepgram grows, while staying close to the day-to-day work that surfaces where systems need to improve. It’s Important to Us That You Have 3–4+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, GTM Systems, Sales Operations, Business Systems, or a related role. Strong hands-on Salesforce experience, including reporting, flows, automation, and data management. Experience working across CRM, CPQ, billing, contract, or other GTM systems. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail. A track record of improving workflows, not just executing existing processes. Comfort using AI and automation tools to reduce manual work and improve operations. Ability to work cross-functionally across GTM, Finance, and technical teams. It Would Be Great If You Had Experience in a usage-based or consumption-based business. Experience with CPQ and contract-generation tools. Familiarity with billing or metering systems. SQL or experience working with GTM/customer data. Experience with tools such as Claude, Cursor, n8n, Workato, Retool, or similar automation environments. Experience in a high-growth SaaS or AI company. Notice : We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @ deepgram.com email address. title: Senior Data Scientist - Product
description: About Us Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback. We grow together: as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. The role As a Senior Data Scientist for Product at Legora you will turn data into decisions. You'll sit close to the business, taking questions end-to-end: shaping the metric, modelling the data in dbt, running the analysis, and making the recommendation. You'll pull in new data sources when you need to. Insights are useful; impact is what we hire for. We're an AI-first data team . We believe the data function should be redesigned around what AI now makes possible, not retrofitted with it, and we want someone excited to help define what that looks like in practice. There's no single profile we hire for. Some of us are strongest at data modelling and analytics engineering, some at experimentation and causal inference, some at machine learning, some at stakeholder influence. You'll likely be excellent at one or two of these and competent across the rest. That's the bar. We're a small, centralised team supporting the whole company, hiring for the person , not the seat. Depending on your strengths and where we have the biggest gap when you join, you could be embedded primarily with: Product : instrumentation, feature adoption, user behaviour, A/B testing, shaping the roadmap with PMs and designers. Finance & RevOps : ARR, NRR, forecasting, board reporting, pricing analytics across a 40-country footprint, and unit economics for an AI-native product. Growth & Marketing : acquisition funnels, attribution, campaign measurement, lifecycle analytics, and what actually moves enterprise legal buyers. GTM & Customer Success : pipeline analytics, customer health, expansion signals, and retention drivers in a category that didn't exist three years ago. You'll partner directly with leaders across Product, Engineering, Finance, and GTM, most of whom are unusually data-fluent and will happily open a SQL editor with you. Your work will directly influence how we prioritise, how we sell, how we price, and how we build. What you will be doing Partner with stakeholders across Product, Finance, GTM, Growth, and beyond to translate ambiguous questions into structured analyses and clear recommendations. Define the metrics that matter, design the experiments or analyses that test them, and measure the impact of what we ship. Conduct deep-dive analyses on the questions that move the business, and proactively surface the questions nobody is asking yet. Model the data you need for your work in dbt, pulling in new sources when necessary, and partner closely with data engineering on anything that needs to scale beyond your immediate use case. Build dashboards and reporting that scale beyond you, so the company can answer its own questions where possible. Help shape how the data team operates as we scale: standards, tooling, ways of working. What you'll need Strong proficiency in SQL and Python . Solid grasp of data modelling and what it takes to build analytical work that is reliable and trusted. Excellent communication skills and the confidence to influence decisions through data storytelling, including pushing back when the data doesn't support what someone wants to do. Genuine depth in at least one of the following, with competence across the rest and curiosity to grow: Data modelling and analytics engineering (dbt, dimensional modelling, semantic layers, self-service) Experimentation and causal inference (A/B test design, quasi-experiments, statistical rigour) Machine learning and applied data science (forecasting, prediction, segmentation, evaluation) Product analytics and metric design (funnels, cohorts, adoption frameworks, North Star metrics) Nice to have Experience in a product-led or SaaS environment, ideally B2B. Hands-on experience with our stack: Snowflake, dbt, Hex, Dagster . Prior experience as an early data hire at a fast-growing company, i.e. you've built the muscle, not inherited it. Most importantly, you are someone who "Gets stuff done" and understands building a $10bn company isn't always glamorous and takes hard work and long hours. Thrives in a fast-paced environment where the answers aren't always clear and processes are few. Is genuinely domain-curious. You don't need to have worked on every part of a business, but you should be excited to. This role covers the cell side of our protein characterisation work. Assay design and the shape of the cascade sit with the scientist who leads this work today, so you are not being asked to invent the panel. You are being asked to make it run the same way every week, to record what you did in a form the rest of the system can read, and to tighten the protocols as they settle, including moving them towards the plate formats our automation will take on. Your first 90 days FIRST 30 DAYS ◆ Take over routine culture and banking for the protein cell lines, working to the protocols we already run. ◆ Learn the panel end to end by running each assay alongside the scientist who owns it. DAYS 60 TO 90 ◆ Hold the weekly assay schedule on your own and return results on the agreed turnaround. ◆ Bring one protocol to a tighter precision bar, or into a plate format ready for automation. Who you are You are a hands-on cell biologist who takes assay variability personally. You have run the same assay often enough to tell a real effect from a bad plate, and you would rather find the cause than repeat the run. The week has a rhythm in this job: cells to feed, plates to seed, runs to finish, numbers to return. You are happy with that, you keep records someone else can pick up, and you say early when something looks wrong rather than at the end of the week. We do not hire people into boxes. NICE TO HAVE ◆ Reporter cell line bioassays for binding or blockade. ◆ Receptor internalisation, lysosomal trafficking or cytotoxicity assays. ◆ High-content or fluorescence imaging, and the image analysis behind it. ◆ 384-well formats, liquid handlers or other plate-based automation. ◆ Flow cytometry, for example for surface receptor quantification. We frequently do informal user research, and value people who can be flexible with research processes and methodologies to achieve the right outcome. • Prototyping. About MoonPay Enterprise MoonPay Enterprise is one of the more operationally complex products in the stablecoin space: multiple banking providers, multiple payment rails, a growing partner base across two product lines (Orchestration and Issuance), and an active compliance surface across each. MoonPay Enterprise runs B2B, B2B2B, and B2B2C models. Partners integrate our API. Their customers become direct customers of MoonPay Enterprise for compliance purposes. KYB is the front door. Every partner is a business. Every business customer of every partner clears KYB before a single transaction moves. Today the flow is part automated registry verification, part manual review, with different rules for the US and the rest of the world, and turnaround measured in days. That does not scale to where MoonPay Enterprise is going. KYB has to become a product: measurable, fast, API-first, defensible in front of regulators and banking partners. This is a principal seat. You set the multi-year direction for how businesses enter MoonPay Enterprise, and you own the outcome. What You'll Own KYB product strategy & roadmap Business onboarding end-to-end, across every model MoonPay Enterprise runs: partners onboarding onto MoonPay Enterprise, businesses onboarding directly, and business customers onboarding through partners. Platform altitude. KYB decisions ripple into KYC, Travel Rule capture, banking-provider onboarding, and Issuance partner diligence. Connect the surfaces; don't optimise one in isolation. MoonPay Enterprise runs three KYC delivery models (reliance, outsourcing, hosted). KYB coverage is uneven across them. You decide where it expands and in what order. Genuine product depth on MoonPay Enterprise is non-negotiable. Within weeks you talk fluently about KYB outcomes, UBO requirements, virtual account structures, and API behaviour. From being hands-on, not from documentation. Onboarding funnel & conversion The KYB funnel is yours: pass rate, time-to-verified against a 48-72h target, manual review rate, drop-off per step. Instrument what isn't instrumented. Make approval speed and rejection quality measurable. Then move both. Fix rejection UX. Today a declined business often gets a status without a reason, and the partner escalates to support to find out what is missing. Rejection reasons, retry semantics, and resubmission flows become API surface partners build on. KYB API & partner experience The KYB API surface: statuses, webhooks, document submission, and the edge cases that make business onboarding hard (sole proprietors, corporate shareholders, one person who is UBO, Director, and Representative at once). Partners integrate KYB in weeks and self-serve their onboarding questions. Every "what is missing for this customer" escalation is a product gap. Close it. Compliance as product Turn compliance-approved onboarding matrices into product logic. US and non-US differ: control prong versus directors, when ownership documents are required, self-certification options. Partners should never need to read a matrix. EDD triggers, high-risk classification, prohibited industries, Travel Rule capture: you decide how they show up in the product. Compliance is your sparring partner, not a ticket queue. You shape how policy becomes product. They own the policy. Vendor & provider orchestration The verification stack (SumSub today) and the build-versus-buy calls around it. Cost per verification, automation rate, vendor performance. Know when a second provider, a waterfall, or in-house tooling earns its place. Push automation. Decide where AI-assisted review with a human in the loop replaces manual queues, and prove it does not raise risk. Every new banking provider brings its own onboarding requirements. Keep KYB compatible with every rail without collecting everything from everyone. Who You Are A principal-level PM with real KYB or KYC depth. You have owned onboarding, identity, verification, or risk as a platform, not a feature. High agency. You do not wait for a mandate, a brief, or perfect data. You find the problem, claim it, and fix it. Full autonomy, zero to one. Hand you an unowned surface and you take it from first principles to shipped. No handover document, no waiting for direction. AI-fluent by default. AI tools are your daily instruments for analysis, prototyping, and drafting. You run your own queries; analysis is not something you request from another team. Compliance is a design constraint, not a blocker. You read a requirements matrix and see API design, funnel steps, and copy. You know your funnel cold: pass rate, time-to-verified, manual review rate, cost per verification. At home in API-first B2B. Your users are partner engineers and the businesses behind them, not consumers. You have run verification vendors (SumSub, Persona, or equivalents) and know when to switch, stack, or build. A multiplier for the product team around you. You raise the bar for how compliance-heavy product work gets scoped, specced, and shipped. Bias to action. Reactive stewardship of an existing flow is not what we are hiring for. Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot. Benefits & Perks 💡 Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot. title: Senior Project Manager (EMEA or USA)
description: Company Overview: At Panopto, we are the most customer-centric learning technology company in the world. As the leader in visual and audio-based learning , we empower organizations to share knowledge effortlessly in a capture and post-capture world. We don’t just build software; we obsess over our users’ goals to deliver solutions that truly matter. Our mission is simple: to attract the brightest talent, people like you, to Elevate the Craft and do the most impactful work of your career. Panopto is looking for a Senior Project Manager to own the execution behind our product initiatives — from the moment we commit to something through the day customers can use it. Position Summary In this role, you will have the opportunity to do the most impactful work of your career, elevating your craft while contributing to a team that values lifelong learning. As the Senior Project Manager, you'll report to the Program Manager and sit inside the Product team on the R&D side, which means the job runs in both directions. Upstream, you're working with Product Managers, Engineering, and Design to keep committed work moving, dependencies visible, and slippage caught early. Downstream, you're making sure Marketing has positioning, Support knows what's changing, Sales can sell it, and customers hear about it the day it goes live. Most project management roles are one or the other. This one is deliberately both, because the handoffs between them are where things fall apart. You'll take initiatives that start as a paragraph and a target quarter, break them into a plan people can act on, and keep a distributed group of teams moving in the same direction until it's out the door. This role is for someone energized rather than frustrated by ambiguity — you'll frequently be the person who turns "we're doing this next quarter" into a sequenced plan with owners and dates, and then holds everyone to it. You’ll also have opportunities to contribute to other initiatives that directly advance our core values and support you in elevating your craft. How You’ll Contribute In this role, you will have the opportunity to Own the end-to-end plan for assigned initiatives — scope, sequence, dependencies, milestones, and readiness criteria from commitment through release. Break large, ambiguous initiatives into discrete workstreams with clear owners, and keep the group aligned as things shift. Work alongside Product Managers and Engineering Leads to track delivery against commitments, surface slippage early, and keep cross-team dependencies visible and resolved. Facilitate the sessions that move work forward — dependency reviews, cross-team planning, release readiness — and make sure they end in decisions. Translate engineering blockers and technical trade-offs into clear, honest updates for Product leadership and commercial stakeholders. Drive go-to-market readiness with Product Marketing, Sales Enablement, Support, and Customer Success so enablement lands with the release, not after it. Coordinate internal and customer-facing release communications, including release notes. Build the templates, checklists, and repeatable processes that make the next release easier than the last one — using AI tooling to cut the manual overhead. What Success Looks Like Within 3 months: You've built working relationships across Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Support, and you own end-to-end coordination for two or more active initiatives — running the delivery cadence with the dev teams and producing status reporting people actually read. Within 6 months: You're anticipating blockers rather than reporting them, and releases you coordinate go out with GTM readiness in place on day one. Within 1 year: You run our most complex, multi-team initiatives with minimal oversight, and the delivery and launch process you've built is what the rest of the team uses by default. Your legacy: Panopto ships predictably, and every team knows what's coming and what they need to do about it — because you built the system that makes that true. Values in Action Customer First, Always : You proactively surface friction points in the customer experience before they are escalated — and propose solutions, not just reports. Thrive Together : You share work-in-progress for early feedback, knowing that challenge improves the outcome. You separate critiques of ideas from critiques of people. Elevate the Craft : You hold the bar high on your own work and invest in developing those around you. You treat every project as an opportunity to learn something new. Act with Ownership : You define success by outcomes, not activity. You flag problems early and bring a proposed path forward, not just the problem. Clarity Over Complexity : You default to the simpler solution. Your written communication — internal or external — is direct, specific, and free of filler. How We Thrive You'll join a team where we challenge ideas, not people. The Product organization exists to ideate, define, and deliver best-in-class products to our customers — assessing market trends, running competitive and customer research, and ruthlessly prioritizing the opportunities with the highest return. We hold ourselves accountable to outcomes, not activity. The Foundation for Success 6+ years of project or program management experience, with at least 4+ years specifically embedded within a B2B SaaS Product or R&D organization. Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience. Demonstrated experience running delivery with software engineering teams and coordinating the go-to-market side of a product launch. This role does both. Proven experience driving delivery for complex SaaS architectures (e.g., API integrations, multi-tenant cloud platforms, feature flags, continuous deployment release models) . Working understanding of the SaaS product lifecycle and agile delivery practices, with the judgment to adapt the process to the situation rather than apply it by the book. Enough technical fluency to hold a credible conversation with engineers about dependencies, trade-offs, and blockers — you don't need to write code, but you can't be a passenger in the discussion. Proficiency with Jira and Confluence for planning, tracking, and documentation. Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to push back constructively on scope creep. Experience working with distributed teams across multiple time zones. Demonstrated track record of designing, implementing, or improving cross-functional delivery and GTM release frameworks, rather than just executing within existing ones. What Sets You Apart Experience coordinating GTM launch activities with Product Marketing, Sales Enablement, or Customer Success. Experience presenting, reporting delivery health, and managing trade-offs directly with VP and C-level stakeholders. Experience sitting inside a Product or R&D organization rather than a central PMO. Active PMP, PMI-ACP, or CSM certification. Hands-on experience leveraging modern PM stacks (Jira, Confluence) and AI productivity tools to streamline status reporting, documentation, and risk analysis. Prior experience in a Product Operations (ProdOps) function. Familiarity with API-based products, feature flagging, or cloud service constraints. Experience in EdTech or with higher education or enterprise customers. Practical use of AI tooling to accelerate planning, synthesis, and reporting work. Join Us Join Panopto and play a key role in shaping the security foundation of a platform used by millions. If you love threat modeling, automating defenses, guiding engineering teams, and turning compliance standards into practical, scalable security practices, you’ll feel right at home here. Total Rewards Base pay offered may vary depending on various factors, including, but not limited to: job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other eligibility factors such as geographic location. The Total Rewards package includes competitive base pay and an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs such as health insurance, flexible spending accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work. At Panopto, we know that great people make an organization great. We value our people and offer employees benefits that are market competitive for our industry. Learn more about what working at Panopto can mean for you. At Panopto, our commitment to pay equity and transparency is unwavering. We do not engage in salary negotiations beyond the established range to maintain fairness and prevent potential pay disparities among team members based on negotiation strategies. Please note: Compensation: For U.S.-based hires, the expected annual base salary range for this position is $138,000 - $148,000 USD. Actual compensation will depend on factors including skills, experience, location, and market data. For candidates hired outside the United States, compensation will be determined using local market benchmarks and will be paid in the applicable local currency. Total compensation and benefits may vary by country. Beyond the Requirements: At this point, we hope you're feeling excited about the job description you’re reading. Even if you don't feel that you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We're eager to meet people that believe in our mission and can contribute to our team in a variety of ways - not just candidates who check all the boxes. We want people to feel comfortable expressing their true selves and to come, stay, and do their best work here. Recruiting Tips: From crafting an impressive resume to presenting your best self during our interviews, we're dedicated to ensuring you feel well-prepared and self-assured as you embark on opportunities at Panopto. Discover some valuable Recruiting Tips from our team. Our user base is as diverse as the world’s universities and businesses. Panopto’s commitment to fostering a fair, equitable, and inclusive culture empowers each member of our team to express their authentic selves, contribute their distinct perspectives and make a meaningful impact both individually and collectively. This inclusive environment not only encourages creativity and the free exchange of ideas but also harnesses the power of varied viewpoints. As a result, we are better equipped to tackle our most intricate challenges, leveraging the wealth of different experiences and backgrounds within our team. This collaborative spirit empowers us to challenge ideas (not people) recognizing that our shared success relies on collective wisdom. It drives us to continuously improve and innovate, ultimately elevating the quality of our products and services. It’s what sets Panopto apart as a unique and rewarding place to work. Our purpose We believe that video can have a transformative effect on learning. So we built a video knowledge management platform that helps businesses and universities improve the way that they train, teach, and share knowledge. Since 2007, we have been a pioneer in video capture software, video management, and inside-video-search technology. Panopto has been adopted by more than 1,600 companies and universities worldwide with over 11 million end users. Today, Panopto’s knowledge management platform is the largest repository of expert learning videos in the world. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About AlphaSense: </strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit <span><a href="http://www.alpha-sense.com" target="_blank">www.alpha-sense.com</a></span>. Come join us.</span></p></div><p><strong>About Expert Insights:</strong><br>Expert Insights, which spans AlphaSense’s Expert Transcript Library and 1x1 Call Services offerings,<span class="Apple-converted-space">  </span>delivers a new and transformative form of market intelligence content. Through transcripts covering thousands of companies, it captures the unfiltered views and insights of business operators in the trenches, interviewed by professional investors who drill into key questions on what’s truly important about a company at each moment in time. title: Architect/Staff Embedded Software Engineer
description: About OLIX AI is growing faster than any technology in history and the explosion in demand has created a massive infrastructure gap; we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The industry is still leaning on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. A new paradigm that is faster and more efficient will be the biggest economic opportunity of the next century and create the most important company of the next decade. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect enables a step change in system level performance. The Role As a Staff Embedded Software Engineer, you will be the design authority for a major area of the DX-1 platform firmware, within the overall platform architecture. This is the software that makes a rack of custom silicon bootable, manageable and observable, from pre-silicon simulation and FPGA prototypes through first silicon into production. The kind of work you would own: bare-metal and real-time firmware on resource-constrained cores, embedded Linux on the platform processors, the BMC and management plane, and register-level control of the ASIC over its management link. You will report to the Platform Architect who leads the Embedded team and work closely with the FPGA, ASIC and Systems Software teams. You bring exceptional depth on both sides of the hardware-software boundary, the judgment to identify what matters most and why, and the ability to influence and align engineering teams without relying on formal authority. It is a hands-on individual-contributor role. We will judge it by what others can build on: specs other teams work to, firmware that is ready when the hardware is, and designs that still hold up a year on. Responsibilities Lead a major area of the platform firmware. Boot and update, platform management or register-level control of the ASIC, agreed with you based on your strengths. Own its design, interfaces and roadmap within the platform architecture, and be accountable for it reaching production. Make the interfaces explicit. Write down the contracts your area depends on and exposes, from register maps to update and telemetry flows, so the teams on either side can build against them. Support bring-up and validation. When a bring-up or test problem turns out to be in boot, drivers or the management plane, you are the person who gets called. Help the teams running it get to the cause, and write up what you find so nobody has to rediscover it. Define failure and update behaviour. How a fault in a node, rail or link is contained so it does not take out the rack, what gets logged so we can find the cause, and what happens if a firmware update is interrupted halfway. Build things the team keeps using. Reference implementations, firmware tests on the infrastructure the validation teams already run, and contributions to the device models. Pick the problems that matter. Identify the highest-impact technical risks in the platform firmware and at its interfaces to the FPGA and silicon teams, and make sure they get solved. Develop the senior engineers around you. Review their designs as well as their code, set them up to lead areas of their own, and take an active part in hiring. Skills & Experience Depth on both sides of the hardware-software boundary. description: About SuperchargeMe SuperchargeMe is one brain for the whole commerce business. Every function has a tool. Nothing runs the whole. We built SuperchargeMe to run the whole. The product is live and brands are paying for it. Getting it in front of the right brands is the next step. That's you. The role in a sentence Be our first marketer and own the go-to-market: fill the sales calendar with CEOs, CFOs, COOs, CMOs and VPs of E-Commerce at mid-market omnichannel brands, and grow the brands that sign up on their own. Who we sell to: mid-market omnichannel brands in the US, UK and EU, selling across their own store, marketplaces, wholesale and retail. Two ways in: brands starting with a single product sign up and get going on their own. Brands that want several platforms working together, with onboarding, book a demo. Run paid media yourself across Meta, Google, LinkedIn and anything else that works, alongside email, retargeting, campaigns aimed at named brands, events, and joint marketing with agencies, Shopify partners and systems integrators. Build and look after the route to a demo: landing pages, the booking flow, qualifying questions, quick follow-up and a clean handover to sales. Grow self-serve sign-ups, from the first visit to an account that's actually using the product, including our Shopify App Store listing. Clicks, impressions and ROAS only matter as far as they get us there. After your first month, tracking is set up properly, you've agreed the list of target brands with sales, and your first campaign is running. After your first quarter, demos and sign-ups come in every week from channels you set up, and you know what each one costs by channel. Sales starts asking for more of one kind of lead, because those are the deals that close. The case studies already being written with our first clients are published, and sales uses them in every deal. You can show the pipeline or sign-ups you've been responsible for, and what they cost. You write well enough that a CMO reads to the end. You build your own reporting in the CRM and analytics tools. You already use AI tools and agents in your day-to-day work and can show us how. We sell AI agents, so we'd expect that. You're comfortable being the first and only marketer for a while. Bonus points You've run a DTC or e-commerce brand. You've built demand from zero at an early-stage B2B company. You've run events or executive dinners in commerce or retail. Skip this one if Your best campaigns needed an agency to run them. You report clicks and impressions and call it pipeline. You'd rather write the plan than ship the campaign. Most brand leaders haven't yet seen AI that takes actions on their business. You'll shape how they first hear about it. You'll work alongside both founders, who ran commerce brands before building software. Decisions are quick, and what you hear from the market gets into the product fast. description: <h4><strong>About the Team</strong></h4> <p>The Professional Services organization at Miro is focused on ensuring our Enterprise customers achieve exceptional outcomes through the Innovation Workspace. Generalist FDCs lead client discussions across industries; as the Manufacturing Specialist, you are the dedicated depth they bring in when a pursuit turns on industrial expertise.</p> <h4><strong>What Professional Services involvement post-sale and hand over cleanly</li> <li>Package what you learn and radiate it—internally to Sales, Marketing, and Product, and externally through thought leadership</li> </ul> <h4><strong>What you’ll need</strong></h4> <ul> <li>8+ years in <strong>top-tier consulting, forward deployed engineering, solution consulting, or enterprise
